Find the route file in the Pinzo Shopify app that renders a feature request or roadmap page. The page shows a list of feature requests with:
- Vote counts (upvote arrows with numbers like 35, 28, 21, 19)
- Feature titles (e.g. "Bulk ZIP code lookup via file upload", "Add timezone info to ZIP results", "Dark mode support", "REST API endpoint for developers")
- Descriptions
- Category tags (e.g. "Data & Export", "UI & Design", "API & Integration")
- Dates
- Status badges (Planned, In Progress, Done, Under Review)
- "View details →" links

Search for files matching patterns like:
- app/routes/app.roadmap*.tsx
- app/routes/app.feature*.tsx
- app/routes/app.changelog*.tsx
- app/routes/app.requests*.tsx

Also search for keywords like "roadmap", "feature request", "Planned", "In Progress", "Under Review", "vote" in route files.

Return the full file path and content of the relevant route file.
